name: Funky Drummer break engine
desc: Clyde Stubblefield in a box: the funkydrummer break chopped 16 ways over two cycles with a 909 kick reinforcing the one, breaking into amen slice rearrangements at peak. Filter breathes over 16 cycles, phrase-end chop reshuffles every 8th cycle.

code.peak: stack(s("funkydrummer").loopAt(2).chop(16).gain(${gain}).shape(${crunch}).lpf(sine.range(3600, 8000).slow(8)).every(4, x=>x.rev()), s("amen").slice(8, "<[0 3 5 7] [0 1 4 6]>").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(${crunch}).hpf(300).pan(.6).mask("<0 1 1 1>"), s("bd ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}*.8).shape(.3).lpf(2800), s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").gain(${gain}*.45).room(.2), s("cr ~ ~ ~").gain(.28).mask("<1 0 0 0>")).orbit(1).play()
